admission.justification: Prevents reusing a passed review result after candidate bytes or Git entry kind/target/executable representation changes, or interpreting failed reads as equality.

applicability: Same-round record-only publication through generic and route fixed-list review paths for the authority-selected candidate.
conditions: The Reviewer has recorded candidate evidence; remaining findings only shrink.
The actual resolver uses successful HEAD-tree and tracked diff reads plus untracked entry representations selected without following links.
Failed required reads remain unproven and cannot establish unchanged equality.
exclusions: Caller candidate strings are not independent authority evidence.
A different or unproven candidate requires begin_review.
Native representation tests are bounded construction evidence, not an exhaustive proof of every concurrent mutation or Git configuration.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_review_state.py (binding proofs); mcp/tests/test_task_doc_review_public.py (probe regressions); mcp/tests/test_candidate_identity.py; evidence-attempt3/focused-pytest.log; evidence-attempt3/integration-route-reopen.log

statement: A same-round record-only result is admitted only on the authority-resolved byte-identical candidate the round was recorded on; replayed claims, absent bindings, unresolvable identities, and clean-record reseals refuse before write.
